meta_description: Power Plus Electrical Services Ltd in Birmingham. NICEIC-approved electrician offering domestic rewires, fault finding, and emergency callouts. Free quotes available.
hero_subhead: Faulty electrics, tripped circuits, or complete rewires in Birmingham. We arrive promptly and fix the problem right.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full property rewires, we handle all domestic and small commercial electrical work.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Tripped circuits, dead sockets, or flickering lights? We diagnose and repair faults same day, often within the hour of your call.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Rewiring an older property cuts fire risk and boosts resale value. We work methodically to minimise disruption and complete on schedule.

services.title: Fault Finding & Testing
services.desc: Unsure what's causing your electrical issues? We use diagnostic testing to pinpoint faults accurately before any work begins.

services.title: Fusebox & Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Upgrade to a modern consumer unit with RCD protection. Safer, more efficient, and often improves your home insurance premiums.

services.title: New Circuits & Socket Installation
services.desc: Adding extra circuits, sockets, or USB outlets? We route cables neatly and install to current building regulations.

services.title: Periodic Electrical Testing (EICR)
services.desc: Annual safety inspections for landlords and older properties. We issue a full test certificate and flag any remedial work needed.

about_pullquote: We treat every job like it's our own home — no cutting corners, no surprises.
about_para_1: Power Plus Electrical Services was founded in 2008 with one aim: to provide honest, skilled electrical work at fair prices. We've grown to complete over 2,400 jobs across Birmingham and the surrounding areas. Every member of our team is fully qualified and insured, and we pride ourselves on arriving promptly and getting the job done right the first time.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we're reliable, transparent, and friendly. We don't use scare tactics or recommend unnecessary work — we fix what's broken and leave your home safer. Whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned rewire, you'll find us straightforward, professional, and genuinely interested in solving your problem.

reviews.text: Had a complete rewire done last year and they were brilliant from start to finish. No mess, worked around our schedules, and everything's been faultless since. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Called them out at 10pm on a Sunday when we had no power downstairs. They came within 45 minutes, tracked down a faulty circuit breaker, and had us back on within an hour. Fantastic service.
reviews.author: Michelle T.

reviews.text: Really professional and friendly. Got a free quote for adding some extra sockets and they explained everything clearly without any pressure. Fair pricing too. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Robert M.
